method: Synthetic ownership annual/lifecycle tick; identical initial league snapshot with 100 independent annual-event RNG seeds × 100 years per scenario; 20000 league-years total. Normal: initial team cash=0, no generated financial stress, event capital retained. Stress: all teams assigned cash=-5000×ecoIdx each annual tick. No baseball, roster dynamics, income/expense settlement or full financial model simulated. Counts exclude ordinary CEO retirements (kind ceo).
